name: 4.5ft Bed Soft Roll-Up Tonneau Cover for 2022-2026  Ford Maverick 4.5' Bed Full Protection with Durable Double-Layer PVC
fitment: Compatible with 2022-2026 Ford Maverick Fleetside 4.6ft Bed.

description:
Designed for Ford Maverick 2022-2026, this durable, double-layer PVC tonneau cover offers full protection for your 5ft truck bed. Easy to install with no drilling, it shields against dust, water, and UV rays while providing convenient full bed access.
Features
Perfect Fit for 2022-2025 Ford Maverick
This soft roll-up tonneau cover is specifically engineered for Ford Maverick, ensuring a flawless fit for your 5ft truck bed. It enhances your vehicle's functionality and overall look, making it an essential accessory for those seeking both style and practicality.
Durable Double-Layer PVC Material for Maximum Protection
Crafted from premium double-layer PVC, this tonneau cover offers superior durability and longevity. The heavy-duty construction is designed to withstand harsh weather conditions, ensuring that your truck bed remains protected from water, dust, UV rays, and other environmental elements.
Complete Bed Protection from Water, Dust, and UV Rays
This tonneau cover offers comprehensive protection for your truck bed and cargo. It effectively seals out rain, dust, and harmful UV rays, keeping your belongings secure and in pristine condition. Whether you're driving through rain or intense sunlight, your truck bed is fully safeguarded.
Tension Latch System for Easy Access and Security
Equipped with a state-of-the-art Tension Latch System at the tail end, this roll-up cover makes it easy to lock and unlock the truck bed. The design ensures that you can access your bed quickly while keeping your cargo secure when the cover is closed, offering convenience without compromising security.
Hassle-Free, No-Drill Installation with Included Tools
The tonneau cover can be installed without any need for drilling or modification to your vehicle. All necessary tools and detailed instructions are included, allowing for a quick and straightforward installation process. Enjoy enhanced truck bed protection in just a few simple steps.
1 Year warranty service, Professional installation is highly appreciated recommended.
Fitment
Compatible with 2022-2026 Ford Maverick Fleetside 4.6ft Bed.
